service.description: A page by wikiPageId, or by its space and exact path (an old path of a moved page finds the page at its new place), with what the user may do (WikiServices.get#WikiPageAccess) checked against need: view (a page the user may not view is "Page not found"), update or admin (an administrator of the space, or the ADMIN group). A page that has no file yet (a link to a page not made) is found with exists false; access is then the space's.

The side pane of Knowledge: the spaces the user may view (get#WikiViewScope; no notes space), each with what the user may do there and its storage; the space to open (wikiSpaceId when given and visible, else the last one opened, the KNOWLEDGE_SPACE preference, else the first); the pages the user opened or changed lately (not notes); the reviews waiting on the user; and the user.

The pages under a page (the space's top pages under its root, pagePath empty), as the tree shows them, loaded as a node opens: path, name, page id, whether it has pages under it and is restricted; in their sequence, then by name. The restricted pages the user may not view (get#WikiViewScope) are left out, and with them what is under them.

A page as Knowledge and Notes show it: its text (the current one, or versionName), title (the first heading, else the name), place (space, path, breadcrumbs), what the user may do, whether it or its space is restricted, the current and published versions, the last change and who made it, its tags and pin, its links and backlinks (get#WikiPageLinks, get#WikiPageBacklinks), attachments, the reviews open on it, the tasks, events and requests it is linked to (the ones the user may see), and whether the user follows it. A page that has no file yet (a link to a page not made) answers exists false. Opening a page (not an old version) adds it to the user's recent pages (the KNOWLEDGE_RECENT preference) and its space as the one to open next.

The page goes first in the user's recent pages (KNOWLEDGE_RECENT, the 20 last, newest first, each the page id and when) and, for a Knowledge space, the space becomes the one Knowledge opens next (KNOWLEDGE_SPACE).

The pages the user opened (KNOWLEDGE_RECENT) or changed (WikiPageHistory rows of the user) lately, the latest first, of the ones the user may still view (get#WikiViewScope) and never another user's notes; with includeNotes the user's own notes too, which link to Notes. Failure tolerant: a part that cannot be read is logged and the rest is answered.

The Knowledge search line and the Notes search: WikiServices.search#WikiPages (the search documents on WikiPage when search is available, else the page paths; never a page the user may not view), in one space or all; scope knowledge leaves every notes space out, notes keeps only the user's own notes.
The pages of a space the user may view, as the options of the Move and New page dialogs' parent drop-down ({value: path, label}), the top level first; the user may add pages there (canUpdate).

parameter.name: excludePagePath
parameter.description: A page and what is under it to leave out (a page cannot move under itself)

service.description: Saves a page's text as a new version (WikiServices.update#WikiPage, with versionNote: the commit message on git, the history note on database files), as a user who may update it. With baseVersionName (the version the editor opened) and not force, a page changed since by someone else is not overwritten: conflict is true with who changed it. A save with a note on a Knowledge page tells the page's followers (RecordFollow, kind changes; failure tolerant). versionName is empty when the text was unchanged. With collab the page's co-edited document is saved instead of pageText.

parameter.name: collab
parameter.description: Save the page's co-edited document (m-coedit) as the version instead of pageText (CollabServices.save#CollabDocument): edits merge as they are made, so there is no conflict to check

service.description: A new page in a space the user may add pages to (WikiServices.update#WikiPage checks it), under a parent page the user may view that is made already (or at the top of a space the user may view), with pageText or a heading of its name; refused when a page is at that path already (its record or its file). A page of the same name elsewhere in the space is another page: the wiki writes each at its exact path.

Duplicate page (Knowledge's menu; design §10 Clone): a copy of a page the user may view, with its text and files and, with withChildren, the pages under it the user may view (each under the copy of its parent, by the same name), as new pages at toParentPath/toPageName in toWikiSpaceId (the page's space by default), a space the user may add pages to (WikiServices.update#WikiPage checks it). Each copy starts its own history, its first version noted with the page it was copied from; with usePublished it is the text of the page's published version. Each page is copied in a transaction of its own (copy#Page, one framework clone#WikiPage without its children), so one that fails is logged and named in failedPaths, with the pages under it, and the others are kept; the first one failing refuses the whole. This walk stays rather than one clone#WikiPage withChildren: each page is its own transaction, a page the user may not view is left out as get#PageChildren does, and a failure is named in failedPaths.

parameter.name: usePublished
parameter.description: Copy each page's published version, not its latest text (the latest for a page with none)

service.description: One page of duplicate#Page, through the framework's clone#WikiPage without the pages under it or its aliases, and unpublished: the text of a page the user may view (its latest, or with usePublished its published version's) as a new page the user may add (update#WikiPage checks both), with its page members and its files (a file that is not copied is logged and named in failedFiles).

actions.script: failedFiles = [] // clone#WikiPage takes the space's id as the parent for the top level (an empty parent is the source page's) const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.clone#WikiPage').parameters({baseWikiSpaceId: fromWikiSpaceId, pagePath: fromPagePath, wikiSpaceId: toWikiSpaceId, parentPath: toParentPath || toWikiSpaceId, pageName: toPageName, withChildren: false, copyAliases: false, copyAttachments: true, publishNew: false, usePublished: !!usePublished, versionNote: versionNote || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return if (!out?.wikiPageId) { ec.message.addError(ec.resource.expand('There is a page ${path} already', '', {path: toPageName})); return } wikiPageId = out.wikiPageId pagePath = out.pagePath failedFiles = Array.from(out.failedFiles || [])

service.description: A new name for a page, in the same place (WikiServices.move#WikiPage, which keeps its history and leaves an alias at the old path, so links to it keep working).

Moves a page with the pages under it and its attachments to another place or space (WikiServices.move#WikiPage: the user must be able to update the page and the target space; into other storage the history is replayed, one version at a time, by its own author and date); an alias at the old path keeps links to it working.

actions.script: const ref = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.get#PageRef').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId, need: 'update'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError() || !ref?.found) return const moved = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.move#WikiPage').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId, toWikiSpaceId: toWikiSpaceId || ref.wikiSpaceId, toParentPath: toParentPath || '', toPageName: toPageName || null, versionNote: versionNote || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return wikiSpaceId = moved.wikiSpaceId pagePath = moved.pagePath replayed = !!moved.replayed versionCount = moved.versionCount || 0

service.description: A page tree drop: the page goes before or after another page (among its siblings) or inside it (under it). A new parent is a move (WikiServices.move#WikiPage); before and after set the siblings' sequence (WikiPage sequenceNum, the tree's order), for a user who may update the space.

Deletes a page the user may update (WikiServices.delete#WikiPage, deleteAttachments) with its files, history, tags, links and reviews, and Mantle's joins to it (its SECA: the comments' WikiPageCommunicationEvent rows, the linked tasks and requests, the followers; the comments themselves stay); a page with pages under it, or the home page of a space, is not deleted. A page record with no file goes too.

Publishes a version of a Knowledge page (the version the public and help-center views read, WikiServices.set#PublishedVersion, which checks the version is the page's and keeps its full name), for a user who may update it. A note has no published version.

A page's versions for the History dialog (WikiServices.get#WikiPageHistory: newest first, with the note, who and when, current, published and where a version came from in a move) and what the user may do with them.

The compare of two versions of a page (WikiServices.get#WikiPageVersionDiff, the server's line diff as its escaped moqui-diff table): from fromVersionName (empty: the version before) to toVersionName (empty: the current).
Writes an old version of a page back as its newest version (WikiServices.restore#WikiPageVersion: nothing in the history is lost), for a user who may update it.

Asks reviewers (user ids, a list or comma text; none: anyone who may update the page, the space's administrators told) to review a version of a Knowledge page (the current one by default) before it is published (WikiServices.request#WikiPageReview), for a user who may update the page. The reviewers' notification opens this page with its review (link).

parameter.name: dueDate
parameter.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the end of that day in the user's time zone

service.description: The reviewer's decision (WikiServices.decide#WikiPageReview, which checks it is the user's to decide): approve publishes the version, changes says what to change (decisionNote). The requester's notification opens what the request's opened (request#Review's link: the page on its review).

actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.decide#WikiPageReview').parameters({wikiPageReviewId: wikiPageReviewId, decision: decision, decisionNote: decisionNote ? String(decisionNote).trim() : null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return statusId = out?.statusId publishedVersionName = out?.publishedVersionName wikiPageId = ec.entity.find('moqui.resource.wiki.WikiPageReview').condition('wikiPageReviewId', wikiPageReviewId).one()?.wikiPageId || null

service.description: Withdraws a review the user asked for (WikiServices.cancel#WikiPageReview: its requester or a space administrator).

actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.cancel#WikiPageReview').parameters({wikiPageReviewId: wikiPageReviewId, note: note || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return statusId = out?.statusId

service.description: Reviews of the pages the user may view (WikiServices.find#WikiPageReviews): filter toDo (the user's to decide), requested (asked by the user) or all; statusId WprRequested by default, any for every status; each with its page, version, who asked and reviews, the dates as text, whether it is overdue, and the link that opens the page on the review's compare. Notes are never reviewed.

A page's tags (WikiPageCategory names, a list or comma text; a name not used before becomes a category), for a user who may update the page. The reserved category Pinned is the pin (set#PagePinned) and stays as it is.
Pins or unpins a page (the reserved category Pinned, which get#WikiSpacePages reads as pinned), for a user who may update it: pinned notes come first in Notes.

Adds files to a page's attachments (WikiServices.upload#WikiPageAttachment, the page's _attachments folder, for a user who may update the page); a file of the same name is replaced (a new version where the storage keeps them). A page not saved yet takes no files.

parameter.name: attachmentFile
parameter.description: An uploaded file or a list of them

service.description: Removes a file from a page's attachments (WikiServices.delete#WikiPageAttachment, for a user who may update the page).

actions.script: const ref = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.KnowledgeServices.get#PageRef').parameters({wikiPageId: wikiPageId, need: 'view'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError() || !ref?.found) return ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.WikiServices.delete#WikiPageAttachment').parameters({wikiPageId: ref.wikiPageId, filename: String(filename || '')}).call()

service.description: An attachment of a page the user may view: its location to send, and whether it may show inline (an image or a PDF; anything else downloads, so no script of an uploaded file runs in the app's origin).

Follows (watches) or stops following a page the user may view: mantle follow#Record and unfollow#Record on the WikiPage record, as Chatter's Follow, with every kind on (messages, notes, activities and saved versions).

Links a page to a task or event (WikiPageWorkEffort) or a request (WikiPageRequest) the user may see (ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.get#RecordInfo, the record visibility of R5 and R28), for a user who may update the page.
Takes a page's link to a task, event or request away, for a user who may update the page.

The tasks, events and requests a page may link to, for the Link to a record drop-down: the Inbox's record search (ironstone.comms.InboxServices.search#LinkRecords: an id, or the search index, each one the user may see) kept to work efforts and requests, as options {value (entity|id), label}.

The user's notes (the notes space of WikiServices.ensure#UserNotesSpace, made on first use) for the Notes list (get#WikiSpacePages with the detail): title, snippet, when changed, tags and pin; pinned first, then the most recently changed. text narrows by search#WikiPages in the notes space and by the title and snippet; tag by a tag. tagList has every tag of the notes with its count.

A new note in the user's notes space (made on first use): named for its title, else "Note" and the time, with a number when the name is taken; its text pageText, else a heading of the title, else empty.
The spaces the user may view (get#WikiViewScope; no notes space) for the Spaces list: description, pages, who may read and write, members, the public URL, the storage, and what the user may do there.

A new space (WikiServices.create#WikiSpace: the creator administers it) on the storage chosen: db (database files, the default), gitdb (a git repository in the database), gitlocal (a git repository on disk) or mirror (a read-only mirror of remoteUrl, for administrators); restrictView and restrictUpdate Y keep it to its members. A space that is written to gets a home page of its description.

A new space with the pages of a space the user may view (WikiServices.clone#WikiSpace: its members come along, the user administers the new one), on database files or a git repository (gitdb, gitlocal); with copyHistory every version of every page is replayed.

A space's settings for SpaceDetail: description, the public URLs, who may read and write, allow any HTML, the storage (for git the repository, its branch, a mirror's URL and the newest commit), the members with their rights, and the restricted pages with who may read or edit each; what the user may do there.

A space's settings, by an administrator of it: description, public page and attachment URLs (http or https), and who may read and write (restrictView, restrictUpdate). Allow any HTML is for the ADMIN group only, since a page's HTML then runs in the app's origin.
Adds a member to a space or changes a member's rights (WikiSpaceUser: view, edit or admin), by an administrator of the space; a space keeps at least one administrator.
Takes a member out of a space, by an administrator of the space; a space keeps at least one administrator.

Restricts who may read (restrictView) or edit (restrictUpdate) a page to its page members (WikiPageUser), by an administrator of its space. A page restricted to its readers is not shown to the space's administrators either (only to the ADMIN group), so the administrator who restricts it becomes a page member and it stays theirs to open up; an administrator edits any page they may read, so restrictUpdate alone needs no member.
Lets a user read (view) or edit a restricted page (WikiPageUser), by an administrator of its space.
Takes a user's page rights away (WikiPageUser), by an administrator of its space.
